comments.comment: Bacterial isolates [25] were maintained on solid MRS medium (Becton Dickinson, Sparks, MD, USA) under aerobic or anaerobic conditions (BBL GasPak anaerobic system, Becton Dickinson, Franklin Lakes, NJ, USA) at either 30 or 37°C.
For carbon source utilization testing, a simpliWed MRS medium (designated MRSsi) was developed by reducing or omitting several components from MRS.
MRSsi contains 5 g of casamino acids, 5 g of peptone, 5 g of yeast extract, 0.5 ml of Tween 80, 0.05 g of MnSO4·4H2O, 0.2 g of MgSO4 ·7H2O, 0. 1g of CoCl2 · 6H2O, and 5 g of sodium acetate per liter.

Concentrated sugars were autoclaved separately and added prior to use. For xylose utilization screening, 5 ml MRSsi cultures containing 4–6% xylose in 14 ml tubes were inoculated at 1% (v/v) from overnight MRS preinocula and incubated at 30°C without shaking.
